About Our Organization

Official organizational profile and public welfare mission

About Our Organization

Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah Memorial Welfare Organization is dedicated to public welfare, social awareness, community service and constructive development.

Our mission is to serve humanity by focusing on education, health, human rights, social welfare, public awareness and community development.

President's Message

Together, we can build a just, educated, peaceful and developed society.

Vision & Mission

Guided by service, dignity, responsibility and community participation.

Our Vision

To contribute towards an informed, responsible and compassionate society where communities actively participate in positive social development.

Our Mission

To promote social welfare, public awareness, community cooperation and constructive initiatives that benefit the public.

Our Values

Integrity, respect, human dignity, transparency, social responsibility and peaceful community engagement.
